Gold Dragon (CV 114)

A golden dragon carries its wings like a ceremonial mantle, with a gaze that is warm until it finds a deliberate cruelty.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +1; Guile +1; Knowledge +2; Reason +1

HP: 56 · Speed: 7; fly 10 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 2*

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: 2 Banes · Stability: 2

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2), Radiant (2)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Dawnfire breath

Target: All creatures in a cone of 3 rows, 1/3/5 squares wide; no exclusions. Each player rolls defense separately. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: radiant.

Weak defense: Blinded 2. Standard defense: Blinded 1.

Limit: Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

Raking claws

Target: One visible creature within 2 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push 3. Standard defense: Push 1.

Limit: Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

Warding Light

A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

Tail Retort

The dragon twists with the blow and its heavy tail sweeps across the attacker's footing.

After an adjacent attacker's attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, push that attacker 2 squares directly away. This creature must survive and remain capable. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision damage; no separate attack damage. Cannot trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 2; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Blind a dangerous clustered advance, then interpose claws and warding light. It can reconsider when shown that its protection is harming the people it values.

Encounter and conversation: Its well-meant protection is keeping a community dependent; honest disagreement may matter more than flattery.

Habitat: Remote domain; defended lair · Communication: Common and Draconic

Loot: Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play
